permitted_claim: Corrected landscapes retain every finite positive-persistence interval and consecutive active level with separate H0 and H1 and exact or error-controlled squared-L2 integration.
prohibited_claim: A fixed grid or universal level cap defines the primary method.

permitted_claim: Cell topology was evaluated reproducibly under fixed study-blocked existing-data conditions and multiple cell-view sensitivities.
prohibited_claim: Cell topology universally recovers tissue or outperforms alternatives.
next_evidence_if_central: external validation if generalization is central

permitted_claim: Gene topology supplies a distinct sample view conditional on the fixed transductive 500-gene SCT panel.
prohibited_claim: The gene panel is inductive or robust to panel size metric and new datasets.
next_evidence_if_central: targeted panel/metric sensitivity and external validation if central

permitted_claim: Cell and gene views should be reported separately and as complementary descriptive geometries.
next_evidence_if_central: external validation is more informative than same-corpus winner testing

permitted_claim: Equal-weight fusion did not reliably outperform both component views under the frozen blocked MRR rule.
prohibited_claim: The descriptive 0.25 gene weight is an improved selected method.
next_evidence_if_central: none unless a future independent dataset prospectively tests fusion

permitted_claim: Integration did not improve the prespecified topology increment over matched energy in this corpus.
prohibited_claim: Integration is generally ineffective or harmful.
next_evidence_if_central: external validation if a general integration claim is desired

permitted_claim: Study and tissue dependence must be shown and discussed as a limitation and scientific result.
prohibited_claim: The equal-tissue macro removes study/tissue confounding.

permitted_claim: Mixed-study approach differences may be reported descriptively with nesting limits.
prohibited_claim: scRNA-seq versus snRNA-seq causes topology differences.

permitted_claim: Topology describes sample geometry and retrieval behavior.
prohibited_claim: Topology alone identifies pathways cell states or mechanism.

permitted_claim: Current results describe the accepted 90-sample corpus.
